explanation: The Kwilu article states plain causation. Of the risings of January and February 1964 it says that "As violence increased and attacks became more frequent, it sparked similar uprisings throughout the country, triggering the Simba rebellion." The Simba article treats the two as one movement and does not say which came first. It says the Simba rising "was contemporaneous with the Kwilu rebellion led by fellow Lumumbist Pierre Mulele in central Congo". The Kwilu article is the one that gives the order and says what the earlier rising did. The type is `caused` because the source says "triggering". The confidence is probable, because Wikipedia is the only source here (rule 22).
